TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT NARRATIVE
AND PLANS
3606 W. Flournoy Avenue

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3606 W. Flournoy Avenue from RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and: Multi-Unit District to a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District in order to
establish a non-required accessory parking lot to serve 600-10 S. Central Park Avenue. Six parking
spaces will be provided. The lot is currently vacant. Only minor construction is contemplated to
effectuate the accessory parking lot use. No building construction is contemplated.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks a variation to permit the off-street
accessory parking lot to be used for any required accessory parking serving a nonresidential use
at 600-10 S. Central Park Avenue under Section 17-13-1101-F.
